name: round 1: hatch
tests: the same seed prints the same genome in two runs
every genome has the required fields, inside the rules' ranges
over 10,000 seeds: at least six species, each 2 % or more, all three affinities, and about one rare creature in 64
uppercase, surrounding spaces, repeated spaces and decomposed accents do not change the creature
seeds in any script, with digits, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes, hatch
a bad seed exits 2 with a reason on stderr and nothing on stdout
the built page loads offline with no error and reports ready with webgl2 or webgpu
?seed= opens that seed's creature, exactly the genome the command prints
typing a seed and pressing Enter hatches it and puts it in the address
a bad seed typed in the page shows a reason and keeps the creature
Random hatches another seed's creature, exactly the genome the command prints
the card shows the creature's name, species, affinity and stats
two seeds draw two different images
the scene is drawn in art pixels of 3 CSS pixels or more
Save GIF downloads an animated GIF: 12 frames or more, 64 colors at most, frames that differ
Save card downloads a PNG card of at least 300 × 300 pixels
the page requests nothing outside its own server
the built page works under a sub-path
